title: Randsburg on screen
text: The lost 1913 movie The Mystery of Yellow Aster Mine was shot in Randsburg. South of Suez, starring George Brent and released in November 1940, was filmed there. Dwight Yoakam's 1989 video for Long White Cadillac was filmed in Randsburg too. Scenes from the 2011 film Cowboys and Aliens were also filmed in the town.
